body:
# please add a stage+config hash to commits /stage history

I want to have a way to establish the proof that something went through a stage in a set config. To this end we should store a hash of the task+stage config and hash of commit. 

This should be put both in stage history and wrap up commits. The goal is going well can prove that a task went through a set stage at a given time. So if we had a compliance requirement we can prove a task went through it
